facts.quote: As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.
We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.
Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.

parsed.subject: Collaboration Proposal
parsed.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting compelling visual narratives for brands. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Stumptown Coffee Roasters, designed to highlight the importance of your Direct Trade relationships. You’ve mentioned that honoring these relationships, paying quality premiums, and creating multi-year commitments are key to your mission, and we believe a shared visual experience would powerfully underscore this. Essentially, the post would showcase the beauty of your coffee and the dedication behind it, inviting viewers to connect with the experience of visiting Stumptown cafes.  We envision creating a visually appealing post that subtly reinforces the value of your partnership and encourages engagement.

Please reply to let us know if you’re interested in exploring this further.

The BrandPilot team
